title: Thriving in the Face of Contradiction

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.

sentences.en: It is the world that has been pulled over your eyes to blind you from the truth.

sentences.en: All of us confront forks in the road.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都会面临人生的十字路口。

sentences.en: They might be less permanent and irreversible than the one confronting Neo.
sentences.zh: 它们可能不像尼奥面临的那个那样永久且不可逆转。

sentences.en: But then again, the choices we confront in real life are real.
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，我们在现实生活中面临的选择是真实存在的。

sentences.en: Should we move to another city or stay put?
sentences.zh: 我们是该搬到另一个城市还是原地不动？

sentences.en: Say yes to a marriage proposal or say no?
sentences.zh: 对求婚说是还是说不？

sentences.en: Reinvent a business or stick to doing what we know best?
sentences.zh: 重塑业务还是坚持做我们最擅长的事？

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, the psychology of dilemmas and how to learn to make better choices.
sentences.zh: 本周的“隐藏的大脑”将探讨困境的心理学，以及如何学会做出更好的选择。

sentences.en: Sometime in the recent past, you have probably wrestled with a dilemma like this.
sentences.zh: 在过去的某个时候，你可能也曾与这样的困境做过斗争。

sentences.en: Should you miss your vacation in order to attend your cousin's wedding?
sentences.zh: 为了参加表弟的婚礼，你该不该错过假期？

sentences.en: Or maybe you've debated whether to make a risky investment.
sentences.zh: 或者你可能纠结过是否要做一笔高风险的投资。

sentences.en: Or perhaps you're asking yourself right now, should you work less to spend more time with your child?
sentences.zh: 或者你现在就在问自己，我是不是该少工作一点，多花点时间陪孩子？

sentences.en: To confront a dilemma is to feel pulled in two directions.
sentences.zh: 面对困境就是感受到被拉向两个方向。

sentences.en: We sense that no matter which course we choose, we are going to lose something important.
sentences.zh: 我们隐隐觉得，无论选择哪条路，我们都会失去一些重要的东西。

sentences.en: Wendy Smith is a psychologist at the University of Delaware.
sentences.zh: 温迪·史密斯是特拉华大学的心理学家。

sentences.en: She studies leadership and organizational behavior.
sentences.zh: 她研究领导力和组织行为。

sentences.en: She also studies how we think about dilemmas and how we ought to think about them.
sentences.zh: 她还研究我们如何看待困境以及我们应该如何看待困境。

sentences.en: So

sentences.en: And then behaviorally, the things that are around us, once we've made a choice,
sentences.zh: 而在行为层面上，我们周围的事物，一旦我们做出了选择，

sentences.zh: 我们就会养成强化这种选择的习惯，从而维持对我们一贯做事方式的承诺。

sentences.en: So what I hear you saying, Wendy, is that even though dilemmas can feel painful, in some ways they're an example of simplified thinking.

sentences.en: That's right.

sentences.zh: 但随后，就像宝丽来一样，乐高开始面临重大的颠覆。

sentences.en: Computer games were getting increasingly popular and starting to steal market share.
sentences.zh: 电脑游戏越来越受欢迎，并开始抢占市场份额。

sentences.en: Lego behaved exactly like Polaroid.
sentences.zh: 乐高的表现和宝丽来如出一辙。

sentences.en: First, they doubled down on their existing model.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们加倍押注于现有的模式。

sentences.en: When that didn't work, they hit the panic button.
sentences.zh: 当这招不灵时，他们按下了恐慌按钮。

sentences.en: It started to spiral like Polaroid down this rabbit hole of committing to its existing approach
sentences.zh: 它开始像宝丽来一样陷入死胡同，执着于现有方法，

sentences.en: and eventually realized that they were going to fail if they did.
sentences.zh: 直到最后意识到如果继续这样下去他们会失败。

sentences.en: so lego is a great example of what they did was that they over corrected they started to say okay
sentences.zh: 所以乐高是一个很好的例子，他们当时矫枉过正，开始说“好吧，

sentences.en: we need to innovate we need to innovate now and we needed to innovate fast and they started to
sentences.zh: 我们需要创新，我们现在就要创新，而且我们需要快速创新”，他们开始

sentences.en: produce all different kinds of sets that weren't just the classic interlocking brick but it was
sentences.zh: 生产各种不同的套装，不再仅仅是经典的互锁积木，而是

sentences.en: all different kinds of pieces within seven years they moved from something like 6 000 different
sentences.zh: 各种各样的零件。在七年内，他们将大约6,000种

sentences.en: types of pieces to 14,000.
sentences.zh: 不同类型的零件增加到了14,000种。

sentences.en: They moved into not just green, but 157 different colors and hues.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅加入了绿色，还推出了157种不同的颜色和色调。

sentences.en: It was at this time that they even moved out of the bricks.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，他们甚至跳出了积木的局限。

sentences.en: That's when they introduced new
sentences.zh: 也就是在这个时候，他们推出了新的

sentences.en: minifigures.
sentences.zh: 人仔（minifigures）。

sentences.en: They had about six different types of chefs and, you know, each one of them just a
sentences.zh: 他们大约有六种不同类型的厨师，你知道的，每一种

sentences.en: little bit more nuanced than the other.
sentences.zh: 都只是比另一种稍微细致了一点点。

sentences.en: That's when they introduced Legoland of the theme park.
sentences.zh: 也就是在这个时候，他们推出了乐高乐园主题公园。

sentences.en: And they start to co-brand with Star Wars and so many others.
sentences.zh: 他们开始与《星球大战》以及其他许多品牌进行联合品牌合作。

sentences.en: So they started to try all different kinds of things in order to keep up with the market.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了跟上市场的步伐，他们开始尝试各种各样的方法。

sentences.en: So they moved from a very conservative approach to try everything and anything possible.
sentences.zh: 所以他们从非常保守的方法转变为尝试所有可能的方法。

sentences.en: I mean, it's almost a wrecking ball phenomenon writ large, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这几乎就是毁坏球现象的全面爆发，对吧？

sentences.en: You're throwing literally anything at the wall, seeing what will stick.
sentences.zh: 你简直把任何东西都往墙上扔，看哪个能粘住。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how this sudden switch in the direction of excessive innovation, how did
sentences.zh: 我想知道，这种突然转向过度创新的方向，是如何

sentences.en: it affect the company and its balance sheet?
sentences.zh: 影响公司及其资产负债表的？

sentences.en: You know, it was this overcorrection, this wrecking ball that almost led them into bankruptcy
sentences.zh: 你知道的，正是这种矫枉过正、这种毁坏球般的做法，差点让他们走向破产，

sentences.en: because what they found was that revenues were going up, but costs were so significant.
sentences.zh: 因为他们发现收入虽然在上升，但成本太高了。

sentences.en: They had skyrocketed to such a degree that their profits were just declining.
sentences.zh: 成本飙升到利润急剧下降的程度。

sentences.en: And they were in a really quick, vicious cycle.
sentences.zh: 他们陷入了一个非常迅速的恶性循环。

sentences.en: They were spiraling downward incredibly quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们的螺旋式下跌速度快得惊人。

sentences.en: So in 2003, the Lego Group announced the biggest loss in its history, and some wondered if
sentences.zh: 因此在2003年，乐高集团宣布了其历史上最大的一次亏损，有些人开始怀疑

sentences.en: the company was going to survive.
sentences.zh: 这家公司是否还能存活下去。

sentences.en: A new leadership team was brought in.
sentences.zh: 新的领导团队走马上任。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: What did they do?
sentences.zh: 他们做了什么？

sentences.en: What actions did they take?
sentences.zh: 他们采取了什么行动？

sentences.en: So the new leadership team looked out and said, OK, well, we need innovation.
sentences.zh: 新领导团队环顾四周后表示，好吧，我们需要创新。

sentences.en: We need new ideas, but not to this extreme.
sentences.zh: 我们需要新的点子，但不能走到这个极端。

sentences.en: and they started to think about how could we come up with some simple rules, some boundaries,
sentences.zh: 他们开始思考，我们如何才能制定出一些简单的规则、一些边界、

sentences.en: some guardrails that would allow us to innovate but not go so far that we're going to fall over
sentences.zh: 一些护栏，既能让我们创新，又不会走得太远而导致跌倒，

sentences.en: and that we're going to fail as a result.
sentences.zh: 并最终导致失败。

sentences.en: And so they then scaled back.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始缩减规模。

sentences.en: They looked across all of
sentences.zh: 他们盘点了所有的

sentences.en: their different pieces.
sentences.zh: 不同零件。

sentences.en: They looked across all their different types and said, okay, what are
sentences.zh: 他们盘点了所有的不同类型，然后说，好吧，哪些

sentences.en: we going to keep and what are we going to get rid of?
sentences.zh: 我们要保留，哪些我们要抛弃？

sentences.en: And became much more disciplined about
sentences.zh: 并且对创新进行了更为严格的管理，

sentences.en: their innovation so that they could reduce their costs while still maintaining these
sentences.zh: 以便在降低成本的同时，依然能够保持市场上这些

sentences.en: new opportunities in the market.
sentences.zh: 新的机遇。

sentences.en: So we saw that Polaroid wasn't able to meet the challenge and eventually filed for bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 我们看到宝丽来没能迎接挑战，最终申请了破产。

sentences.en: What became of Lego?
sentences.zh: 乐高后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: Lego ended up succeeding, in fact, and living in this ongoing tension.
sentences.zh: 事实上，乐高最终成功了，并且在这种持续的张力中生存了下来。

sentences.en: In fact, in their 2020 annual report, their group CEO said that they had hit a year of record profit,
sentences.zh: 事实上，在他们2020年的年报中，集团首席执行官表示他们迎来了创纪录利润的一年，

sentences.en: calling on this need to maintain a commitment to being both creative and disciplined over time.
sentences.zh: 并号召大家继续保持对兼具创造力与纪律性的长期承诺。

sentences.en: After nearly destroying the company with binary thinking, Lego changed its entire philosophy.
sentences.zh: 在差点因二元对立思维而毁掉公司之后，乐高改变了其整体哲学。

sentences.en: Like the Jewish texts Wendy had read, the company began to realize that success was not about eliminating paradoxes, but living with them.
sentences.zh: 正如温迪读过的犹太经典一样，这家公司开始意识到，成功不是消灭悖论，而是与悖论共存。

sentences.en: This is what's so beautiful about Lego is that they have built this idea of paradox now not only into how they think about innovating and how they approach their products and their market.
sentences.zh: 乐高最美妙的地方在于，他们现在不仅把悖论的理念融入了他们对创新的思考、对其产品和市场的态度中。

sentences.en: They've built it into how they think about leadership.
sentences.zh: 他们还将其融入到了对领导力的思考中。

sentences.en: They've built it into how they think about the culture of the company.
sentences.zh: 他们将其融入到了对公司文化的思考中。

sentences.en: So, you know, they talk about the importance of being able to lead and be out in front,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，他们谈到了既能领导并冲在前面、

sentences.en: but also hold oneself back and enable space for other people.
sentences.zh: 同时又能克制自己并为他人腾出空间的重要性。

sentences.en: They talk about the importance of being able to trust one another, but also to verify,
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了彼此信任的重要性，但同时也要核实，

sentences.en: to be able to keep an eye on what's happening so that you are able to feel confident.
sentences.zh: 要能够关注正在发生的事情，以便让自己感到自信。

sentences.en: They talked about, you know, an important one.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了一个很重要的方面，你知道的。

sentences.en: They talk about being courageous and certain to be sure of yourself, but also have some
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了要勇敢、确定、对自信，但同时也要有一些

sentences.en: humility and to, you know, be curious and open to new possibilities and wonder if there's other
sentences.zh: 谦逊，你知道的，要保持好奇心，对新的可能性保持开放，并思考是不是还有其他

sentences.en: ways to do things.
sentences.zh: 做事的方法。

sentences.en: And so these are really baked into how they talk about their culture,
sentences.zh: 因此，这些真正融入了他们对文化的阐述中，

sentences.en: what they inculcate in the organization, and what they hope and expect out of their people.
sentences.zh: 融入了他们在组织中培养的品质，以及他们对员工的期望和希望中。

sentences.en: How well have you come to practice these principles in your own life, Wendy?
sentences.zh: 温迪，你在自己的生活中把这些原则践行得怎么样？

sentences.en: I love the word practice because indeed it's an ongoing practice.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢“践行”这个词，因为这确实是一个持续的践行过程。

sentences.en: It's something that
sentences.zh: 这是一个

sentences.en: on one hand when I hear an either or question be asked I have this immediate gut reaction to change
sentences.zh: 一方面，当我听到有人提出二元对立的问题时，我会有一种本能的反应去改变

sentences.en: the question from the either or to how can we do one and the other and at the same time I still find
sentences.zh: 这个问题，将其从二元对立变成我们如何才能既做到这一点又做到那一；同时我也发现

sentences.en: myself I often find myself getting caught in a particular point of view wanting to argue for it
sentences.zh: 自己仍然会发现自己常常陷入某个特定的观点中，想要为之辩护，

sentences.en: and I learned a long time ago that I need to remind myself to stay quiet to pause to listen
sentences.zh: 而我很久以前就学到，我需要提醒自己保持安静、暂停、倾听，

sentences.en: to hear the differing ideas before I come to a conclusion.
sentences.zh: 在得出结论之前倾听不同的意见。

sentences.en: And so my reminder to myself often to do that
sentences.zh: 因此，为了提醒自己做到这一点，我经常

sentences.en: is to go into a meeting.
sentences.zh: 在开会时这样做。

sentences.en: I will draw a little X on my hand
sentences.zh: 我会在手上画一个小小的X

sentences.en: and the X will say, Wendy, keep quiet.
sentences.zh: 这个X会提醒我：“温迪，保持安静。”

sentences.en: And the value of doing that is that
sentences.zh: 这样做的价值在于，

sentences.en: I spend more time listening before I come to a point of view
sentences.zh: 我在形成观点之前会花更多时间倾听，

sentences.en: so that I can engage with these different perspectives.
sentences.zh: 以便能够与这些不同的视角进行交流。

sentences.en: I do think it's an ongoing practice
sentences.zh: 我确实认为这是一个持续的践行过程，

sentences.en: and I think it's emotional.
sentences.zh: 我也认为这涉及情感层面。

sentences.en: It is hard.
sentences.zh: 这很难。

sentences.en: And one thing that we talk about is it requires us to constantly recognize the discomfort of
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的一点是，它要求我们不断认识到生活在这些对立观点中的

sentences.en: living in these opposing ideas and try and work through that to find comfort in that discomfort.
sentences.zh: 不适感，并努力克服它，从而在这种不适中找到舒适感。

sentences.en: Today's story comes from Walter Delgado.
sentences.zh: 今天的这个故事来自沃尔特·德尔加多。

sentences.en: Walter grew up in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特在萨尔瓦多长大。

sentences.en: When he was young, his mother moved to the United States
sentences.zh: 他很小的时候，他的母亲搬到了美国

sentences.en: to earn money for the family,
sentences.zh: 为了给家里赚钱，

sentences.en: so Walter lived with his grandparents.
sentences.zh: 所以沃尔特和他的祖父母住在一起。

sentences.en: My mom one day called me and she said,
sentences.zh: 我妈妈有一天打电话给我，她说，

sentences.en: do you want to come to the United States?
sentences.zh: 你想来美国吗？

sentences.en: And obviously I was 11 years old
sentences.zh: 显然我当时11岁

sentences.en: And I kept hearing good things about the United States.
sentences.zh: 我一直听到关于美国的种种好消息。

sentences.en: And I said, yes, when do I leave?
sentences.zh: 我说，好啊，我什么时候走？

sentences.en: The first part of the trip, we were traveling in buses.
sentences.zh: 行程的第一部分，我们都是坐大巴。

sentences.en: It was all the way until we got to the Mexican border with the USA that that's when things got serious.
sentences.zh: 一直到我们到达墨西哥和美国的边境，事情才变得严肃起来。

sentences.en: And we were all in a warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我们都在一个大仓库里。

sentences.en: And I'm talking about like 200, 300 people in a big warehouse.
sentences.zh: 我是说，一个大仓库里大概有两三百人。

sentences.en: And one time they came and said, okay, we're ready.
sentences.zh: 有一次他们过来，说，好了，我们准备好了。

sentences.en: And we're going to walk through the desert an entire night.
sentences.zh: 我们要连夜穿过沙漠。

sentences.en: And that's when it hit me.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我心里咯噔一下。

sentences.en: I was like, wow.
sentences.zh: 我想，哇。

sentences.en: I was traveling with my grandfather.
sentences.zh: 我是和我的祖父一起旅行的。

sentences.en: I was 11 and he was old.
sentences.zh: 我11岁，而他年纪大了。

sentences.en: So I was like, this is going to be rough.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，这下可难办了。

sentences.en: And we started walking.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始步行。

sentences.en: And I remember that I was wearing the worst shoes you can choose to walk in the desert.
sentences.zh: 我记得我穿的是你能在沙漠里走路时挑选的最烂的鞋子。

sentences.en: I was wearing the worSt.
sentences.zh: 我穿的是最烂的。

sentences.en: It was uncomfortable, rough.
sentences.zh: 既不舒服，又磨脚。

sentences.en: It was dark.
sentences.zh: 天很黑。

sentences.en: And we were not prepared for those temperatures.
sentences.zh: 而且我们对这种气温根本没有准备。

sentences.en: I mean, again, we come from Central America.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再说一次，我们来自中美洲。

sentences.en: Over there, it's tropical weather.
sentences.zh: 那里是热带气候。

sentences.en: Nobody was prepared.
sentences.zh: 谁都没有做好准备。

sentences.en: And the whole time we were cold, we were walking.
sentences.zh: 一路上我们又冷又走。

sentences.en: I could hear women crying.
sentences.zh: 我能听到女人的哭泣声。

sentences.en: And, you know, like sometimes they're complaining of pain, their legs and, you know, heavy breathing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有时她们在抱怨疼痛、腿疼，还有，你知道的，粗重的喘息声。

sentences.en: All those things are the most that I remember.
sentences.zh: 这些是我记忆最深刻的事情。

sentences.en: I met Modesto along the way.
sentences.zh: 我在路上遇到了莫德斯托。

sentences.en: For the most part, he was quiet, slim, 5'10".
sentences.zh: 大体上，他很安静，身材苗条，身高约五尺十寸。

sentences.en: And I remember we just had, you know, normal, casual, like small talk, like where you from, you know, all that.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们只是进行了，你知道的，正常、随意的闲聊，比如你从哪来，你懂的，诸如此类。

sentences.en: I didn't know that guy from back home.
sentences.zh: 我在老家根本不认识这家伙。

sentences.en: I didn't know anything about him.
sentences.zh: 我对一无所知。

sentences.en: That's when, you know, like after six hours of walking and my feet started giving out,
sentences.zh: 就在那时，你知道的，走了六个小时后，我的双脚开始支撑不住了，

sentences.en: like I was tired and I just remember that I told him, like, hey, man, I can't, I can't
sentences.zh: 我累极了，我只记得我对他说，嘿，老兄，我走不动了，走不动了

sentences.en: my legs and he just can't pull me up, you know, put me on his bag and started walking
sentences.zh: 我的腿，然后他毫不犹豫地把我拉起来，你知道的，把我放在他的包上，开始走

sentences.en: and he told me, don't worry, we almost there.
sentences.zh: 他对我说，别担心，我们快到了。

sentences.en: We're going to make it.
sentences.zh: 我们能成功的。

sentences.en: I'm going to make sure you're going to make it.
sentences.zh: 我会确保你能成功。

sentences.en: And those are the words that he kept saying.
sentences.zh: 这些就是他一直挂在嘴边的话。

sentences.en: You know, we're going to make it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们能成功的。

sentences.en: We're going to make it.
sentences.zh: 我们能成功的。

sentences.en: Of course, you get those thoughts, you know, like, am I going to be left behind?
sentences.zh: 当然，你会有这种想法，你知道的，比如，我会不会被抛弃？

sentences.en: I mean, there's so many people that they don't make it in that journey.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有那么多人在那次旅程中没能挺过来。

sentences.en: So, you know, we just met on the trip.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们只是在旅途中相遇。

sentences.en: And to have the goodness, the willingness to carry someone,
sentences.zh: 但能有这种善意、这种愿意背负别人的心，

sentences.en: I must have been at least 90 pounds, probably 100 pounds.
sentences.zh: 我当时体重至少有90磅，可能100磅。

sentences.en: He easily probably carried me for two to three hours.
sentences.zh: 他很轻松地可能背了我两到三个小时。

sentences.en: I am not exaggerating.
sentences.zh: 我一点也没有夸张。

sentences.en: And I just imagine, like, you know, he must have been tired too, you know, the whole time.
sentences.zh: 我只是想象一下，你知道的，一路上他肯定也很累，你知道的。

sentences.en: It just blows my mind.
sentences.zh: 这简直让我大开眼界。

sentences.en: And it's one of those defining moments in my life where, like, you know, it gives me hope.
sentences.zh: 这是我生命中具有决定性的时刻之一，你知道的，它给了我希望，

sentences.en: and I can see that human beings can be a channel of goodness to the world.
sentences.zh: 我能看到人类可以成为向世界传递善意的渠道。

sentences.en: It takes me back to that, that we can be good, and we can do good to others.
sentences.zh: 这让我回想起这一点，我们可以善良，我们可以对他人好。

sentences.en: You never know how you're going to impact other people.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道自己会如何影响他人。

sentences.en: Small gestures can go a long way.
sentences.zh: 小小的举动可能会产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: Eventually, Walter and his grandfather made it to their destination.
sentences.zh: 最终，沃尔特和他的祖父到达了目的地。

sentences.en: He became a U.S.
sentences.zh: 他成了一名美国

sentences.en: citizen, went to college, and has a good career.
sentences.zh: 公民，上了大学，并拥有了美好的职业。

sentences.en: For all of that, he credits Modesto.
sentences.zh: 这一切，他都归功于莫德斯托。

sentences.en: Everything that I have now, everything that I've accomplished now,
sentences.zh: 我现在拥有的一切，我现在取得的一切成就，

sentences.en: it takes me back to that moment.
sentences.zh: 都让我想起那个时刻。

sentences.en: I can make more money, I can live comfortably.
sentences.zh: 我可以赚更多的钱，我可以过上舒适的生活。

sentences.en: I have a good life now, thank God, and thanks to Modesto,
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝，也感谢莫德斯托，我现在的生活很好，

sentences.en: because he was the one that made it all possible.
sentences.zh: 因为是他让这一切成为可能。

sentences.en: Walter Delgado lives in Houston.
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·德尔加多住在休斯敦。
